caption: The drawing depicts a building with architectural features resembling a mission-style structure rendered in shades of black and grey on a beige or light-colored background. The central part of the composition shows a staircase with curved banisters leading up to an arched doorway, which is framed by columns and topped with an arch. Above the doorway, there are three circular embellishments and a quatrefoil window. At the very top of the structure is a cross. Flanking the main structure are two arched openings, one to the left and one to the right, with the left side enhanced by shading to suggest depth. Some cracks are visible on the building, indicating wear. At the bottom of the drawing, a ribbon-shaped banner contains text reading "1797 Misión Santa Margarita" with the initials "RC" to the right. The entire drawing is created with fine, precise lines and stippling to suggest texture and shadow.
title: Mision Santa Margarita
